description: Find clinical trials near a LOCATION. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "clinical trials for X near me", "recruiting studies in <city/state/country>", "trials I can join near <place>". Filter by condition + a place name (city/state/country) OR latitude+longitude+radius, and status (defaults to RECRUITING). Returns matching trials (NCT id, title, status, phase, conditions, sponsor). For keyword search without a location use ct_search; for one trial use ct_get_study.

condition.description: Condition/disease (e.g. "diabetes", "breast cancer immunotherapy"). Optional but recommended.

lat.description: Latitude for a geo-radius search (pair with lon).

location.description: Place name — city, state, or country (e.g. "Boston", "California", "Germany"). Use this OR lat+lon.

radius_mi.description: Radius in miles for a lat/lon search (1-500, default 50).

status.description: Overall status filter (default RECRUITING). e.g. RECRUITING, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED.

name: ct_trials_by_location
title: Ct Trials By Location
